auth.description: Authenticate Claude Code via OAuth (sends URL to connector, waits for code)

check.description: Run readiness checks (tools, auth, bridge connectivity)

health.description: Check if worker tmux session is running

onboard.description: Extract files and set up credentials for first-time use

flags.--dry-run: Show what would be extracted without writing
flags.--identity: Age decryption key (saved to state for future use)

run.description: Extract files, verify integrity, install hooks, launch worker with watchdog

flags.--identity: Age decryption key (saved to state, auto-loaded on next run)

env_vars.FORGE_BRIDGE_URL: Override --bridge-url (usually not needed — manifest has default)
env_vars.FORGE_IDENTITY: Override --identity (usually not needed — state file remembers)
env_vars.FORGE_OUTPUT_JSON: Set to 1 to enable JSON output
